line: Crowley on Atu XIV: Sagittarius, the path from Yesod to Tiphareth, and the Arrow of directed Will (pdf p92, p94, p95).

sections.title: Sagittarius and the Arrow
sections.line: Crowley on Sagittarius, the opposite to Gemini (pdf p92), and on the Arrow as the glyph of Mercury and the symbol of directed Will (pdf p94).

quotes.quote: It pertains to Sagittarius, the opposite to Gemini in the Zodiac,
The Arrow is, in fact, the simplest and purest glyph of Mercury, being the symbol of directed Will.

sections.title: The path of the card
sections.line: Crowley on the path from the Moon of Yesod to the Sun of Tiphareth (pdf p92) and on Atu XIV between Atu XIII and XV (pdf p95).

quotes.quote: his path leads from the Moon of Yesod to the Sun of Tiphareth.
Between them, Atu XIV leads similarly to the sphere which formulates Existence.
